intents.title: Revamp Timeline & Turns, add Google Maps zoom, drag-and-drop, clean canvas callouts, and pinned bookmarks
intents.rationale: Fix React invariant 300 in NodeInspector, fix sdrop display:none in styles.css, implement Google Maps semantic zoom across maps, enable node drag-and-drop in Constellation and Topology, remove 4 intrusive canvas callouts, remove redundant Atlas/Acme branding, restore Bookmarking in Sidebar and NodeInspector, add invariant pin in .afwe/pins.yaml, and overhaul Timeline & Turns workstation to match reference design.

assumptions.text: Studio UI wires StudioPrefs bookmarks to Sidebar navigation and NodeInspector
